content.title: Chapter 42 - FIRE PREVENTION AND PROTECTION — Sec. 42-83. - I.F.C. Section 3310.3.1, Dimensions.
content.summary:
Section 3310.3.1. Dimensions,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"3310.3.1. Dimensions.
Temporary fire apparatus access roads shall have an unobstructed width of not less
                  than 24 feet (6096 mm) and a vertical clearance of not less than 13 feet 6 inches
                  (4115 mm).…
